# Paw Weather: Dog Walk Tracker

> An iPhone dog walk app: it estimates asphalt and concrete temperature from your local forecast and gives a GO / CAUTION / DANGER verdict for paw burns and heatstroke, warns about ice, frostbite and road salt in winter, and logs your dog's walks and care. English and Japanese. Japanese App Store name: 犬の散歩記録と路面温度 Paw Weather.

## Key facts (for an average adult dog)

- Paw pads: pavement around 125°F (about 52°C) injures skin in about 60 seconds. The app says CAUTION from 110°F (43°C) pavement and DANGER from 125°F (52°C). Puppies: 5°F (about 3°C) stricter.
- Asphalt on a clear day: published spot measurements put asphalt near 125°F at 77°F air (about 52°C at 25°C). Concrete runs 14–25°F (about 8–14°C) cooler.
- Heatstroke: judged on the heat index (temperature + humidity). CAUTION from 80°F (27°C), DANGER from 90°F (32°C). Air at 100°F (38°C) or above is DANGER. Stricter for flat-faced breeds, puppies, seniors and dark coats in direct sun.
- The 7-second rule: hold the back of your hand on the pavement for seven seconds; if you can't, it is too hot for paws.
- After sunset: checked against 16 Arizona DOT roadway sensors about 3.7 hours after sunset, asphalt was still 6.8°F (about 4°C) above the air on average.
- Winter: shaded pavement freezes before the air on clear, calm nights. Feels-like below 32°F (0°C) is CAUTION, below 15°F (−9°C) is DANGER. Wipe paws after walks on salted roads.
- Pavement temperatures are estimates; the app is an educational planning tool, not veterinary advice.

## What it does

- Separate verdicts for paws (pavement) and heat (heatstroke), naming which one tripped
- Hour-by-hour bar for the next 18 hours showing good walk windows
- Thresholds fitted to the dog's breed, age, coat colour and thickness
- Walk recording (route, pee and poop, photos), care log (meals, water, weight, medicine, condition), calendar, memories, medals
- From version 1.5.4: rain for the next 60 minutes during a walk (Apple Weather); records carried to a new iPhone through the user's own iCloud Drive; two-pane layout on the foldable iPhone Duo (the right side stays as the folded screen, details on the left)
- Paw Weather Pro (in-app purchase) adds the 7-day walk planner, smart alerts, the whole log and more dogs
- Weather data: U.S. National Weather Service in the United States, MET Norway elsewhere, Apple Weather for rain by the minute
- No account, no ads, no analytics
